extracted.intended_audience: CIA senior management, OGC, OPPB, and Executive Director/Comptroller
extracted.subtask_short: reply to OMB on Circular A-63
extracted.subtask_description: Drafting and recommending an agency response to OMB's request for comments on the proposed revision to OMB Circular A-63 implementing E.O. 11671, including legal positions on applicability and operational recommendations for interacting with OMB. The memo sets out legal bases, recommended action, and coordination steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability of E.O. 11671 disclosure provisions to CIA
rubrics_metrics.description: The proposed reply takes the position that the disclosure provisions of E. O. 11671 are inapplicable to CIA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Position derives from Agency views concerning the pending executive order and certain legislation concerning committee management, as set out in the Legislative Counsel memorandum of 8 June (approved by the Director on 29 June). As indicated in the proposed letter to Senator McClellan attached to the OLC memorandum of 8 June, the disclosure provisions of what is now E. O. 11671 would be inapplicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classification of USIB and its subcommittees under EO definitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine whether USIB and its subcommittees fall within the EO definitions of 'advisory committee,' 'industry committee,' or 'interagency committee.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agency view: USIB subcommittees would not be 'advisory committees' because they are composed wholly of government officials; they are not 'industry committees'; and they are not 'interagency committees' because they are established by the Director of Central Intelligence as Chairman of USIB and under authority of a National Security Council Intelligence Directive, not 'by a department or agency.' See subsections 1(6), (7) and (8) of the Executive Order. Also note OMB may have intended a different meaning, and prior practice/reporting may complicate this interpretation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consideration of prior reporting practice under existing Circular A-63 and predecessor EO
rubrics_metrics.description: Account for the Agency's historical reporting to OMB under existing Circular A-63 and the then-current Executive Order for the years 1966 through 1971.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although definitions of the two Orders are not significantly different, past reporting to OMB may affect expectations; acknowledge continuity and potential difficulties arising from previous practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain cooperative relations with OMB International Division
rubrics_metrics.description: Preserve good relations with OMB, particularly the International Division, while asserting the Agency's legal position.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OPPB advises Agency has very satisfactory relations and recommends furnishing any information the International Division desires concerning CIA participation in USIB and other committees, 'with or without the existence of an Executive Order requiring us to do so.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Assert Director's position and powers as head of Central Intelligence
rubrics_metrics.description: Make clear the Director's position and powers in communications responding to OMB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Important to maintain good relationship with OMB but also to make clear the Director's position and powers as head of Central Intelligence; recommended reply should reflect and preserve that clarity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommended procedural action: sign and dispatch draft reply
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommendation that the draft reply to the Assistant Director of OMB be signed and dispatched and that OPPB advise the International Division of the reply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifically: 'it is our recommendation, therefore, that the draft reply at Tab B to the Assistant Director of OMB be signed and dispatched and that OPPB advise the International Division of our reply to the Assistant Director and assure that Division that the Agency will furnish it whatever information on committee activities which the Division may request.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Use internal legal memoranda and concurrence in formulating and documenting the reply
rubrics_metrics.description: Base the Agency's position on internal legal analysis and obtain/record concurrence from relevant offices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The position derives from the Legislative Counsel memorandum of 8 June (approved by the Director on 29 June) and references an OLC memorandum. Distribution and concurrence lines (e.g., CONCURRENCE: OPPB) are included to document internal coordination (Original - OGC w/background; ExDir; ER; OPPB; OLC).

rubrics_metrics.name: Timely response to OMB comment deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure the Agency responds within OMB's requested comment period (comments requested by 7 July on the proposed revision).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Memo notes OMB's memorandum of 22 June requesting comments by 7 July and that it would be 'well to go on record with OMB in this regard in timely fashion.'
